legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera keeps gliding forward from the garden path onto the gravel terrace under the brick vaults and slows to a gentle glide along the long candlelit table at seated eye level, neighbors of all ages laughing and passing a bowl, a grandmother holding a blond toddler on her lap, two older men laughing, a girl filling water glasses from a clay jug. Only one toddler in the scene.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. As dinner ends the camera drifts with the people down a short lantern lit path to the round stone fire circle and settles low beside the flames, a grandmother in a blanket holding a blond toddler, a guitar, kids leaning in close. Calm fire, no sparks above any building. Only one toddler in the scene.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera lowers and pushes in slowly toward the fire circle until the flames fill the frame and only dark trees and night sky remain behind. The fire burns low and calm with gentle flames and smoke only: no sparks, no embers, nothing rising into the sky, nothing near the building.
